headings.styles: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), varying weights (font-light to font-black)

rules: Use #0066FF strictly for primary actions, active states, and highlights.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Use Zinc/Slate palette (e.g. text-zinc-950, border-zinc-200).
Maintain high contrast. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
Prohibited: teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

surfaces.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px subtle inner border border-zinc-200. No fully transparent headers.
surfaces.cards: Neumorphism / Technical: Flat white background, 1px solid border (border-zinc-200), no deep shadows. Hover: subtle shadow-lg and -translate-y-1.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-collapse or 1px border-zinc-200 to create a structured, technical grid layout.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full on children for uniform height.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, dense content. Mobile-first responsive grids.

motion.interactive: Hover states must have transitions. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease. Hover state color must be a lighter/darker hue of ACTIVE state color.

components.cards: Flat, rectangular, dense styles. Avoid heavy shadows. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-md or rounded-lg).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Calendar. Highly customized to match Stripe/Linear aesthetic.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts. Use simple Line/Bar charts. Avoid 3D or complex charts unless required.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Clear hover/focus states with higher contrast.

icons_and_assets.style: Enterprise icons, consistent stroke width (1.5px or 2px), sharp edges.

content_assets.description: Minimalist Data Visualization for Content Pillars
Abstract analytical background for research sections

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Light Theme explicitly as requested ('White background. Blue highlights.').
Use Manrope for headings and Inter for body text. Do not use generic fonts for headings.
Apply 'Crystal Glass' to the sticky header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, with a 1px border-b border-zinc-200.
Avoid heavy shadows. Rely on 1px borders (border-zinc-200) to separate components.
Ensure grids have 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' and child cards stretch fully.
Build the multi-step AI Post Generator as an interactive bento layout, preventing scrolling if possible, or keeping it extremely tight.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
